eln: Resolution 2694 already authorized monitoring and verification of the Government–ELN ceasefire.

guard_issues.span: the Secretary-General confirms a ceasefire with appropriate verification protocols and takes into account the implementation update
guard_issues.reason: The sentence assigns both verbs to the Secretary-General. He confirms the ceasefire, and Council consideration takes his update into account.

common_ground: Brazil and A3 support a conditional future Government–EMC verification role, while Resolution 2704 granted no such authority.
